The youngest person in a group is 25 years old. Nora is 72 years old and is in the group. Nora is the oldest person in the group.

Compare the quantities
Quantity AQuantity B
the range of ages in the group47
review2-sessions-q25.explanation: Nora is the oldest person, so the maximum age is 72. Range = maximum − minimum = 72 − 25 = 47.
